title: Defensive Breeze
description: Makes the breeze look more defensive
body:
I wanted to see how the breeze would look like if it was defensive. (Also my first time editing models.) The breeze now hides behind it's rods, acting defensive.
Requires Optifine. Get [here](https://optifine.net/downloads).
Preview:
![Overhead shot of a breeze](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/385293dfc27f844426de72ed8cd1500d121e5d33.png)
